faqs.question: Do you offer custom carpet sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialise in made-to-measure carpets and rugs. Share your room dimensions at any branch or through our contact form for a quotation.

faqs.question: How many showrooms do you have?
faqs.answer: Five showrooms across Gilgit-Baltistan: Gilgit, Hunza, Skardu, Gakuch and Kashrot. See the Store Locator for addresses and phone numbers.

faqs.question: Can I order online and pay on delivery?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery is available for confirmed standard orders in supported areas. Custom and quotation-based orders require confirmation before dispatch.

faqs.question: Do you install flooring?
faqs.answer: Professional installation is available for flooring and wall-to-wall carpet in selected regions. Ask your branch for availability and pricing.

faqs.question: How long has Jalal's been in business?
faqs.answer: Jalal's has served homeowners across Gilgit-Baltistan since 2005, with nationwide delivery.

faqs.question: Who is Jalal?
faqs.answer: Jalal's Home Solution is a premium home furnishings retailer in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, operating since 2005 under brands including Jalal Carpets and Pak Turk Carpets.

faqs.question: What does Jalal sell?
faqs.answer: Our live online catalog includes curtains, carpets (rugs and wall-to-wall), and prayer mats. For current products and prices, browse the website or ask me to search the catalog.

faqs.question: Do you offer free delivery?
faqs.answer: Free delivery is available on orders above Rs. 50,000 within supported regions. Smaller orders and remote locations may incur a fee quoted at checkout.

faqs.question: What is your return period?
faqs.answer: Standard ready-made products may be returned within 7 days if unused and in original packaging. Custom and made-to-measure items cannot be returned unless there is a manufacturing defect.

faqs.question: Why might the chatbot price differ from the website?
faqs.answer: Prices and stock change frequently. Jalal Assistance always checks live catalog prices before quoting — if you see a discrepancy, refresh the product page or contact us.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Branches are open daily. For exact hours, please call your nearest branch — phone numbers are on our Store Locator page.

faqs.question: Can I visualize products in my room?
faqs.answer: Room visualization is planned as part of Jalal Assistance. When available, you will upload a room photo, select a product, and preview it on relevant surfaces. Check the website for current availability.

faqs.question: Can Jalal Assistance help me choose products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your room type, preferred style, colours, and budget. I will search our live catalog and explain recommendations — I won't suggest products that aren't in our database.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Log in to your account to see order status, or contact us with your order number. Once dispatched, you'll receive phone or email confirmation with an estimated delivery window.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to shop?
faqs.answer: You can browse without an account. An account helps track orders and speeds up checkout.
